For the last quarter of 2026, what did the licence-fee service ask me to pay, and on which date?

response.text:
Beitragsservice Musterstadt asked for the Rundfunkbeitrag (broadcasting licence fee) for Q4 2026:

- **Amount:** €55.08, due with transfer by Thu 12 Nov 2026 [item:itm_xna048xewpad]

This is a quarterly payment (repeating every 3 months), with the next one following on 15 Feb 2027 [item:itm_xna048xewpad].

Note: there's also a separate letter in your records claiming to be from a "Rundfunk-Beitragsservice Zahlungszentrale" demanding payment to a Lithuanian IBAN — Ordnung flags this as showing scam signs, since the genuine Beitragsservice has used a different (German) account before [doc:doc_hjxvf5t7dqnw].
